executive_summary.headline: Only 68.2% of cases follow the Signavio happy path (27.9 days); 31.8% incur rework and exception loops taking 36.5 days (+8.6 days longer).
key_takeaways: Major shadow activities discovered: Post-PO Price Changes (13.6% of cases, +8.8 days delay) and Payment Blocks (2.3% of cases, +11.4 days delay) are not modeled in Signavio.
Invoice Receipt -> Payment wait averages 11.7 days (10.6M case-days total), representing the largest throughput bottleneck.
Maverick Buying: 77,964 cases (7.0%) record an invoice before the PO item is created in ERP, violating procurement controls.
77,156 PO items (6.9%) end in rejection, deletion, or block due to late demand verification.

activities.name: Create Purchase Requisition
activities.conformance_notes: Prescribed initial step. 21.1% of PO items bypass PR creation directly.

activities.name: Send Purchase Order
activities.conformance_notes: High conformance (97.6%). Dispatches PO to vendor.

activities.name: Change Price (Post-PO)
activities.conformance_notes: Undocumented shadow rework in Signavio. Occurs ~7 days after PO send; adds +8.8 days delay.

activities.name: Receive Order Confirmation
activities.conformance_notes: Vendor order confirmation logging; trigger for reminder notices in 52.1k cases.

activities.name: Goods Receipt
activities.conformance_notes: Key physical logistics milestone. Vendor delivery lead averages 8.1 days.

activities.name: Record Invoice Receipt
activities.conformance_notes: 5.8 days posting lag after Goods Receipt due to manual entry.

activities.name: Set / Remove Payment Block
activities.conformance_notes: Undocumented exception loop. Set -> remove block takes 5.0 days, then release -> payment takes 12.8 days.

activities.name: Pay Invoice
activities.conformance_notes: Terminal settlement step. 11.7 days wait from invoice receipt.

transitions.notes: Largest waiting time block (10.6M case-days). Driven by batch payment runs and payment term holds.
Invoice posting delay post delivery due to paper/manual intake.
PO dispatched with incorrect contract or catalog price.
Maverick buying / retroactive PO creation after vendor invoice arrival.

deviations.title: Post-PO Price Modification
deviations.description: 152,092 items (13.6%) have prices modified ~7 days after PO dispatch, adding +8.8 days of delay.
deviations.cost_impact_est: $450,000 / year in manual touches and renegotiation
deviations.recommendation: Sync contract & info-record master data before PO release; model price tolerance gateway in Signavio BPMN.

deviations.title: Maverick Buying (Invoice Before PO)
deviations.description: 77,964 items (7.0%) receive an invoice before the PO item is created in ERP.
deviations.cost_impact_est: High compliance exposure, loss of contracted discounts
deviations.recommendation: Enforce strict No-PO-No-Pay ERP controls and route unmatched invoices to guided retro-PO approval.

deviations.title: Payment Block & Release Loop
deviations.description: 25,468 items (2.3%) incur payment blocks, adding +11.4 days (42.2 vs 30.7 days). Release to payment takes 12.8 days.
deviations.recommendation: Implement automated 3-way matching with tolerance auto-release and same-day payment scheduling.

deviations.title: Invoice-to-Payment Queue Latency
deviations.description: 905,259 transitions wait an average of 11.7 days between invoice posting and payment settlement.
deviations.recommendation: Calibrate due-date dynamic payment scheduling and eliminate batch payment holding queues.

bottlenecks.root_cause: Batch payment run cycles and manual hold queues
bottlenecks.remedy: Automate 3-way match and calibrate due-date payment scheduling

bottlenecks.root_cause: Vendor lead time and lack of EDI ASN tracking
bottlenecks.remedy: Deploy supplier portal with automated advance shipping notices (ASN)

reconciliation_plan.description: Insert exclusive XOR gateway after 'Send PO' to model legitimate supplier price confirmation loop with 4-eyes approval.
reconciliation_plan.owner: BPM Center of Excellence & Lead Architect

reconciliation_plan.description: Block invoices in ERP without prior PO reference to eliminate 77.9k maverick buying cases.
Model 3-way match tolerance check and payment block handling sub-process in Signavio.
Deploy automated match bot for invoices within +/- 2% price/quantity tolerance to release payment blocks immediately.
